systems.heading: University Systems
systems.subheading: Access official university platforms for registration, learning, and communication.

banner.name: Banner
banner.description: Course registration, schedules, academic records, and university services.
banner.instructions: Sign in with your official university account. Use Banner to register for courses, view your schedule, and access your academic records.

smartLearning.name: Smart Learning
smartLearning.description: Course materials, assignments, quizzes, and learning resources.
smartLearning.instructions: Sign in with your official university account to access your course materials, assignments, and quizzes.

muster.name: MUSTER
muster.description: Official student mobile application for timetable, grades, doctor evaluation, and student services.
muster.instructions: Download MUSTER from the App Store or Google Play and sign in with your official university account. A web portal is not available yet.

teams.name: Microsoft Teams
teams.description: Online lectures and communication with academic advisors.
teams.instructions: Sign in with your official university account. Academic advisors communicate with students exclusively through Microsoft Teams.

outlook.name: Outlook
outlook.instructions: Sign in with your official university account to access your university email. If you forget your password, use the password reset tool below.

foundation.title: MITSU foundation is ready
foundation.description: Phase 0 complete. Theme, language, and project structure are working.
